This update was also given the name '''Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Update''', as this update added the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. This update encompassed twelve updates, the main v1.41.0 update (released 13 November 2024) and eleven minor updates, v1.41.1 (released 13 November 2024), v1.41.2 (released 13 November 2024), v1.41.3 (released 14 November 2024), v1.41.4 (released 14 November 2024), v1.41.4a (released 16 November 2024), v1.41.5 (released 16 November 2024), v1.41.6 (released 18 November 2024), v1.41.6a (released 19
